method: ASteCA synthetic-cluster likelihood sampled with DEMetropolis (300 chains x 1000 after 1500); NOT converged per P01 itself; 'q50' is the mode

isochrone.computed_with: curve recomputed at P01's mode with erotica's EEP interpolation (96ce4c0); P01's own curves came from ASteCA
isochrone.definition: single-star isochrone (no binaries, no errors) at the posterior median of met/loga/dm/Av, in the observed system: G and BP-RP with CCM89+O'Donnell extinction, R_V=3.1

notes: met is linear Z (MIST Zinit); [M/H] = log10(Z/0.0142) = +0.23
